do.text: In a form or a composer, put the picker behind a button: it opens in a sheet only when wanted.

dont.text: Don't leave a whole picker open in a form for one emoji: it takes the screen.

do.text: Give the button a label saying what the emoji is for ("Project icon"): screen readers read it with the emoji.

dont.text: Don't leave the label empty: a screen reader then hears only "rocket", with no idea what it sets.
